STAGE: verification blocked by sandbox read permissions (BRad-RQ r2, verifier 1/1, DDP/collectives/shared-state).

GOAL: read train_rqvae.py, model/model.py, model/layers.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/frechet_poincare.py, tests/test_ddp.py, the manifest and the previous findings, then judge (1) DDP reduction/collectives/rank symmetry and (2) shared-state equality across ranks.

WHAT I READ: only files inside my own agent workspace (opencode.json, execution.json, running.json, session.jsonl, progress.jsonl). execution.json lists the six in-scope tree files as allowed, and opencode.json carries per-file "read" and "external_directory" allow entries for exactly those six paths plus the manifest and findings file.

WHAT I OBSERVED: every attempt to open any tree file is refused before content is returned:
- read /fs04/.../trees/round_20261029_093253_576/BRad-RQ/model/model.py -> "Permission denied: external_directory"
- read /home/wlia0047/.../BRad-RQ/model/model.py -> same
- grep path=<tree file or tree dir> -> same
- glob path=<tree dir> -> same
- read of files INSIDE the workspace (opencode.json, progress.jsonl) -> "Permission denied: read"
- relative traversal ../../../../trees/... -> "Permission denied: external_directory"
The permission objects in opencode.json put "*": "deny" first and the specific allow patterns after it; the effective matcher denies, so the allowlist never applies. Code Mode exposes no filesystem read tool, browser.preview/file:// are not readable routes, and there is no shell.

REASONING: I cannot inspect a single line of the trainer, the model, or the DDP test, so I cannot name a collective, cannot confirm find_unused_parameters/static_graph settings, cannot confirm that the radius table is built from rank-0-only data and broadcast, and cannot confirm the SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch. Reporting PASS would be a fabrication; reporting a code defect would also be a fabrication. The honest verdict is that the candidate cannot be cleared by this review, and the blocking item is the sandbox permission layer, not the candidate's code.

STILL OPEN: everything in my area (DDP parameter coverage, collective ordering, codebook/radius-table initialisation across ranks, single-process vs four-rank equivalence).

ANSWER TO PRINT: VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX, with the finding being the unreadable tree (blocking, environmental).
